gallery.description: Capt. Richard Pate, a Walter Reed National Military Medical Center nurse, checks an IV for a simulated patient during an Expert Field Medical Badge competition at Joint Base McGuire-Dix-Lakehurst, N.J., Oct. 6, 2015. The competition candidates had to run through a tactical combat care course while evading simulated attacks and attending to patients. (U.S. Air Force photo/Senior Airman Tara A. Williamson)

gallery.title: File:330-ps-7174-usn-709404 16795171195 o.jpg
gallery.description: 330-PS-7174 (USN 709404):   Versatile Corpsmen Perform Nursery Duty-Weighing In.   Hospital Corpsman Third Class Wendell Pugh weighs in a new-born infant as part of his daily nursery routine.   Exact records must be taken from the time of admission until the baby is turned over to the mother.  Location was at the National Naval Medical Center, Bethesda, Maryland, March 1955.   (3/11/2015).
